san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-a.title: San Bernardino · Splügen Long Alpine Day + Silvretta · Montafon Overnight Gateway
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-a.region: Splügenpass hairpins to Silvretta High Alpine
san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-a.slogan: Two days · overnight at Chur fuel

waypoints.name: Chur fuel and status gate
waypoints.advice: Chur fuel and status is where the day begins. Next is San Bernardino pass road, climbing 1473 m.

waypoints.name: San Bernardino pass road
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2066 m here. The road climbs 1473 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Mesocco, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Mesocco food reset
waypoints.advice: A break here. You lose 1276 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 2 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Next is Splügenpass hairpins, climbing 1324 m.

waypoints.name: Splügenpass hairpins
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 2114 m up. The road climbs 1324 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Thusis return, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Thusis return gate
waypoints.advice: You lose 1394 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Back to Chur fuel.

waypoints.name: Back to Chur fuel
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 678 km. Next is Sargans.

waypoints.name: Sargans fuel gate
waypoints.advice: Fill up here — 308 km left and no pump marked after this. Next is Bludenz food stop.

waypoints.name: Bludenz food stop
waypoints.advice: Somewhere to get off the bike, 431 km in. Next is Arlberg return option, climbing 1205 m.

waypoints.name: Arlberg return option
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 1793 m up. The road climbs 1205 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 9 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Silvretta High Alpine Road, climbing 239 m.

waypoints.name: Silvretta High Alpine Road
waypoints.advice: Silvretta High Alpine Road tops the climb at 2032 m. Next is Montafon overnight base, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Montafon overnight base
waypoints.advice: 616 km in you reach Montafon overnight base. You lose 1382 m on the way down to it, steadily. Next is Back to Sargans, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Back to Sargans
waypoints.advice: Back to Sargans closes the day.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 114 km. 1473 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Passo dello Spluga
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2066 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 44 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

san-bernardino-spl-gen-long-alpine-day-a.story: A one-way ride of 648 km, Chur to Sargans - roughly 13 h 02 in the saddle. The stops in between: Mesocco and Thusis. The climbs: San Bernardino pass road, Splügenpass hairpins, Arlberg  option and Silvretta High Alpine Road. It tops out at 2,114 m. San Bernardino Pass, Splugen Pass, Arlberg Pass and Bielerhohe are open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. It crosses from Switzerland into Austria - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It is a high-mountain day.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 34 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-the-palace-and-park-ensemble-sobs.story: 272 km from Petrodvorets to Petrodvorets, about 4 h 41 of riding. On the way it passes Volkhonskoe Highway, Prioratsky Park, The Blocade Ring and back through Prioratsky Park. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
